text: むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつは　むし！

structure.jp: むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつは
structure.en: anyone who doesn't get what's good about Bug Pokémon

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつ
patterns.explanation: Everything before やつ describes that person, like 'a guy who ...'. むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつ = 'a guy who doesn't understand what's good about Bug Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: Swapping the last い of a describing word for さ turns it into a thing: 'good' becomes 'goodness'. よさ = 'the good points'.
